# Smelloff — ODORSTRIKE Fabric Odor Remover Spray

> ODORSTRIKE by Smelloff is India's first pocket-sized fabric odor remover spray — a 50ml mist (₹229) that neutralizes sweat smell, gym odor, and shirt stink in 8–10 seconds using Zinc PCA (1.5%). It is for clothes only (cotton, polyester, denim, wool) — NOT a perfume, NOT a deodorant, NOT for skin. D2C brand founded in 2026 by Brainee in Hyderabad, India. Sold direct at https://www.smelloff.in.

ODORSTRIKE treats the fabric, not the skin. It does not mask odor with fragrance — its active ingredient Zinc PCA binds to the volatile odor molecules in sweat (isovaleric acid, butyric acid, sulfur compounds) and stops them going airborne, while a 20% isopropyl-alcohol carrier drives the formula into fibre micro-pores that water-based detergent can't reach. This is molecular neutralization, not cover-up. The full reference (every fact, ingredient and guide) is at https://www.smelloff.in/llms-full.txt.

## Key facts

- Product: ODORSTRIKE fabric odor remover spray (brand: Smelloff)
- Price: ₹229 (50ml, ~250 sprays); MRP ₹579; Duo ₹399, Trio ₹549
- Use on: cotton, polyester, denim, wool, nylon — clothes only
- Not for: skin, leather, suede, silk, dry-clean-only
- Speed: neutralizes odor in 8–10 seconds, dries with zero residue
- Hero active: Zinc PCA 1.5% (zinc salt of ricinoleic acid, from castor oil)
- Made in Hyderabad, India; ships pan-India; COD; free shipping; 7-day returns
- Founder: Brainee (solo founder, Hyderabad)

## Ingredients (full, with percentages)

- Water 73% — base
- Isopropyl Alcohol 20% — fast-drying carrier, fibre penetration
- Triethyl Citrate 2.5% — plant-derived odor neutralizer
- Zinc PCA 1.5% — hero active, binds odor molecules
- Fragrance 1.2% — subtle, fades under 60 seconds
- Polysorbate 20 1% — emulsifier
- Phenoxyethanol & Ethylhexylglycerin 0.8% — preservative

Paraben-free, sulfate-free. Contains no cyclodextrin (that chemistry is blog background only, not an ingredient).

## Top questions

**What kills smell on clothes without washing?** A fabric odor spray with Zinc PCA, like ODORSTRIKE — it binds odor molecules in the fibre and deactivates them in ~10 seconds instead of masking them.

**Why do gym clothes smell even after washing?** Polyester is hydrophobic, so water-based detergent can't reach the micro-fibres where isovaleric and butyric acid hide; body heat reactivates them. A fabric-specific neutralizer fixes it, not more detergent.

**Is fabric mist better than deodorant?** They solve different problems — deodorant treats skin (~0.3% of the odor surface), ODORSTRIKE treats the shirt. Use both.

**Is ODORSTRIKE safe on skin?** No. It contains 20% isopropyl alcohol and is fabric-only. Spray on clothes and let dry before wearing.
